name: Piloto prospectivo de bloques jsdom

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: ownership-jsdom-block-pilot-v1-global
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
  GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
  GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
  TOOLS: reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages
  PILOT: reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot
  RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
  RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_LABEL: ${{ github.event.label.name }}

jobs:
  preflight:
    if: github.event.pull_request.number == 80 && github.event.label.name == 'ownership-jsdom-block-pilot-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      consumption-artifact: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.artifact-id }}
      consumption-sha: ${{ steps.once.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages/
            /reports/validation/range-numeric-composed-package/20261026/archive.json
            /reports/validation/owner-batch-capture-method/review.json
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot/
            /reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/capture-method/
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-capture.yml
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-contracts.yml
            /.github/workflows/ci.yml
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '22.12.0'
      - name: Materializar los inputs autenticados del método publicado
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-preflight"
          python -B "$TOOLS/checkout.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-preflight/checkout.json"
      - name: Exigir una única secuencia y CI previo del mismo SHA antes de cualquier DOM
        id: once
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          node "$PILOT/capture/once.cjs" "$RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_HEAD" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-preflight/capture-consumption.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-preflight/receipt-sha.txt" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-preflight/once.stderr.log"
          printf 'sha256=%s\n' "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-preflight/receipt-sha.txt")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Derivar los 32 criterios del calendario fijo
        id: plan
        run: |
          matrix=$(node -e 'const {calendar}=require("./"+process.env.PILOT+"/blocks.cjs"); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({include:calendar().map((criterion, ordinal)=>({node:criterion.node.slice(1),criterion:criterion.criterionId,ordinal}))}));')
          printf 'matrix=%s\n' "$matrix" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        id: publish
        if: always()
        with:
          name: jsdom-pilot-consumption-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-attempt${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-preflight/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  capture:
    needs: preflight
    name: Criterio ${{ matrix.ordinal }} Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 200
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.preflight.outputs.matrix) }}
    env:
      CRITERION: ${{ matrix.criterion }}
      RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_CONSUMPTION_SHA256: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.consumption-sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Registrar el inicio real del presupuesto global de setup
        run: |
          read -r started_uptime unused </proc/uptime
          printf 'RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_JOB_STARTED_UPTIME=%s\n' "$started_uptime" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_PILOT_CONSUMPTION=%s/pilot-consumption/capture-consumption.json\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages/
            /reports/validation/range-numeric-composed-package/20261026/archive.json
            /reports/validation/owner-batch-capture-method/review.json
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot/
            /reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/capture-method/
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-capture.yml
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-contracts.yml
            /.github/workflows/ci.yml
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - name: Hidratar fuente y extraer el paquete sellado sin construirlo
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job"
          python -B "$TOOLS/checkout.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/checkout.json"
          python -B "$TOOLS/transport.py" --extract reports/validation/range-numeric-composed-package/20261026/packages.tar.xz "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-package" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/package-extraction.json"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.consumption-artifact }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-consumption
      - name: Fijar la expectativa del controller desde el Git real y el recibo autenticado
        run: node "$PILOT/capture/expectation.cjs" capture "$CRITERION" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/expected.json" --supervised
      - name: Capturar exactamente 512 procesos sin reintentos ni sustituciones
        timeout-minutes: 183
        run: python -B "$PILOT/capture/supervise.py" --capture "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/supervisor.json" "$(command -v node)" --expose-gc "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$PILOT/capture/run.cjs" --capture "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-package" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-criterion" "$CRITERION" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/capture.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/capture.stderr.log"
      - name: Conservar íntegramente datos, parciales y diagnóstico del controller
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-criterion"
          for name in supervisor.json capture.stdout.log capture.stderr.log; do
            if test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/$name"; then
              node "$PILOT/capture/io.cjs" --copy-new "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/$name" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-criterion/$name"
            fi
          done
          python -B "$PILOT/capture/archive.py" --pack "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-criterion" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/criterion.tar.gz" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/archive.json"
          if test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/expected.json"; then
            node "$PILOT/capture/verify.cjs" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-criterion" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/expected.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-job/replay.json" --allow-partial
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          name: jsdom-pilot-criterion-${{ matrix.ordinal }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-attempt${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-job/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 90
